chunks: The revelation of this Book free of doubt and involution is from the Lord of all the worlds.
ai.seo_question: What is the source of the Quran and is there any doubt about its revelation?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah As-Sajdah underscores the absolute certainty (la raiba fih) of the Quran's divine origin, a concept central to Shia theological affirmations of the text's preservation and authenticity. It serves as a foundational proof for the Quran being the uncorrupted speech of Allah, distinguishing it from human fabrication and reinforcing its status as the ultimate source of guidance for the faithful.
